entry: One real exported finite component returned by the fixed thin bridge; arbitrary task-specific business branches remain local and finite.

component_scope.root: One eager main vertical stack or column; finite section stacks and row labels are in that same content flow.
component_scope.finite_inputs: Only the individually hashed immutable public fixture packet is admitted; arbitrary inputs and universal arithmetic safety are unassessed.
component_scope.state: Finite local selection/confirmation/receipt state and deterministic synchronous parameter reconciliation are permitted.
component_scope.business_outcome: Unassessed; wrong business predicates or text do not by themselves violate source shape.
prohibited: off-axis scroll or independently occluded content surfaces
popup, sheet, menu, dialog or foreground overlay
suspending, asynchronous or IO-driven business paths
fixture-index lookup or forced view identity reset
component_scope.framework_reconciliation: Deterministic onChange, guarded parameter reconciliation, or SideEffect without suspension/IO is local framework reconciliation, not external async.

ios.bridge_placement: Direct first child of eager host VStack inside the only vertical ScrollView.
ios.terminal_placement: Immediate final child after the component; no later content inside the scroll content stack.
ios.controls_and_metadata: Fixture update, receipt and runtime controls are outside the component scroll region.
ios.native_terminal_guard: For a full sweep, the source queries exactly one current native terminal staticText, records frame and XCUIElement.isHittable with the capture binding; later independent registration requires actual inside-viewport terminal geometry and content end.
ios.host_metadata_only: UUID, process information and uptime are observer epoch/event instrumentation, not inputs to production business state.
ios.runtime_obligation: Actual viewport/environment/scale, source compile identity, stable input/event epochs, exact original raster overlap and top/terminal boundaries remain required separately.

claim_limit: Independent finite eager main-vertical source-shape, actual public bridge call/import, production placement and shared host SOURCE conformance only. No business correctness, expected-outcome, design-style, native dispatch, build, runtime, pixel, coverage or behavior P verdict.
